parameters.name: Lambda
parameters.description: EFT cutoff Lambda [GeV] of the Weinberg operator (eq:dim5Lag); paper benchmark 200 TeV

parameters.name: Cll
parameters.description: Wilson coefficient C5^{ll'} of the Weinberg operator (dimensionless), eq:dim5Lag; benchmark C5 = delta_{l,mu} delta_{l',mu} (Les Houches NUPHYSICS 2-7)

parameters.name: mN
parameters.value: Abs[Cll[1,1] + Cll[1,2] + Cll[1,3] + Cll[2,2] + Cll[2,3] + Cll[3,3]]*vev^2/Lambda
parameters.description: m_N = |sum_ll' C5| v^2/Lambda (eq:heavyNMass): absorbed 1/Lambda, mass dimension 1, units GeV; benchmark |sum C5|=1 and Lambda=200 TeV give 0.3025 GeV (paper table 0.3 GeV)

parameters.name: wN
parameters.description: Gamma_N [GeV], Internal per tab:ufoParams (Les Houches 9900012); the paper gives no dynamical width for the off-shell EFT mediator N, hence 0

lagrangian_terms.name: LNkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, I/2 NMbar.Ga[mu].del[NM, mu] - 1/2 mN NMbar.NM]

lagrangian_terms.name: LNW
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, ff}, Sum[-gw/Sqrt[2] W[mu] NMbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.l[ff] + HC[-gw/Sqrt[2] W[mu] NMbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.l[ff]], {ff, 1, 3}]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LNZ
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, ff}, Sum[-gw/(2*cw) Z[mu] NMbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.vl[ff] + HC[-gw/(2*cw) Z[mu] NMbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.vl[ff]], {ff, 1, 3}]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LNGP
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{ff}, Sum[-I*gw*mN/(2*Sqrt[2]*MW)*GP*(1 + gw/(2*MW)*H)*(NMbar.ProjM.l[ff] + bar[CC[l[ff]]].ProjM.NM) + HC[-I*gw*mN/(2*Sqrt[2]*MW)*GP*(1 + gw/(2*MW)*H)*(NMbar.ProjM.l[ff] + bar[CC[l[ff]]].ProjM.NM)], {ff, 1, 3}]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LTotal
lagrangian_terms.expression: LNkin + LNW + LNZ + LNH + LNGP + LNG0 + LGG1 + LGG2
